questions: The plausible attachment alternatives are shared negation over business operation and profit objective, independently negated alternatives, and negation confined to business operation with an affirmative profit-objective alternative. The first and third prior shared-negation formulas are logically equivalent, so they do not establish distinct interpretations.

Does the independently negated-alternatives reading warrant supplying an omitted negative auxiliary before “have”? It remains a possible editorial reconstruction, but is less directly supported than shared negation.

Can the first-predicate-only reading survive the surrounding paragraph's treatment of profit purpose as evidence of business status? Its affirmative profit-objective alternative is syntactically arguable but contextually strained.

The additional substantive alternative retained below concerns whether the parenthetical exhausts business status. The supplied text does not conclusively settle this relationship. No further exclusive-disjunction reading is proposed because the text provides no substantive reason to exclude arrangements satisfying both negative conditions.

assumptions: The conclusion retains should not in the ordinary course; this predicate does not establish a licensing exemption or compliance.
Business status remains case-specific under the surrounding paragraph and its non-exhaustive factors.
The wider regulated-activity, carve-out and territory questions remain outside this antecedent experiment.

This bounded experiment uses income beyond reimbursement as the sentence's parenthetical operational reading of being run as a business; this is not a general business classification and may be inadequate.
Facts concern the same arrangement and period; unknown or conflicting evidence is not filled in.
Negation governs both coordinated predicates; the irregular “is ... or have” construction is understood as denying both business operation and a profit objective.
Within this bounded encoding, absence of income beyond reimbursement represents absence of business operation.

citations.quote: A genuine single family office arrangement, established to serve the investment needs of members of a single family, which is not being run as a business (i.e. not receiving any income, other than reimbursement of operating expenses from the family) or have the pursuit of profit as its business objective, should not in the ordinary course be considered as carrying on a business from a licensing perspective.

readings.distinction: Shared negation requires both negative conditions. True means genuine family arrangement, no income beyond reimbursement, and no profit objective. This existing reading is retained as the comparison baseline and is contextually preferable to making pursuit of profit sufficient, without treating that preference as a settled legal interpretation.

facts.meaning: The arrangement is a genuine single family office established to serve the investment needs of members of a single family.

facts.meaning: The arrangement receives income other than reimbursement of operating expenses from the family.
facts.name: income_beyond_reimbursement

facts.meaning: The arrangement has the pursuit of profit as its business objective.
facts.name: profit_objective

citations.quote: What amounts to “carrying on a business in Hong Kong” is not defined in the Ordinance and will need to be determined by reference to the facts of each case, including whether the person is performing an occupation or a duty which requires attention; the activity involves continuity; the activity is capable of making profit; and the activity was carried out for the purpose of making profit.
which is not being run as a business (i.e. not receiving any income, other than reimbursement of operating expenses from the family) or have the pursuit of profit as its business objective

readings.distinction: This substantive alternative was not separately retained in the prior formulas: case-specific business operation remains part of the antecedent itself. True requires a genuine arrangement satisfying the described income restriction, lacking a profit objective, and not being operated as a business on the relevant facts. The same supplied Boolean values could therefore be insufficient to establish this antecedent. The explicit “i.e.” weighs against this reading, but the preceding case-specific qualification gives it a contextual basis.
questions: Does the preceding case-specific qualification govern business operation within this antecedent, or only the ultimate business-status conclusion?

How should continuity, attention-requiring duties, profit capability and other relevant circumstances determine business operation here? The supplied facts contain neither those circumstances nor a rule combining them, so a faithful executable predicate cannot be provided.
Is the parenthetical an exhaustive equivalence for this sentence? If so, this contextual alternative collapses into the operational baseline rather than remaining a distinct reading.
readings.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] Under the contextual reading, the disputed antecedent requires a genuine single family office that receives no income beyond reimbursement, lacks a profit objective, and is not operated as a business on the relevant case-specific facts.

vocabulary_concerns: income_beyond_reimbursement does not independently express case-specific business operation. Using it as a complete substitute suppresses the distinction retained in the null-formalization reading.

The supplied facts omit continuity, attention-requiring duties, profit capability and other case-specific circumstances. Adding an opaque business-status judgment would not explain how those circumstances determine the disputed antecedent.

The Boolean experiment does not encode “should not in the ordinary course”, regulatory intent, regulated activity, carve-outs or territorial conditions. These limitations concern the guidance and wider licensing inquiry, not additional invented Boolean antecedent conditions.

The grammatical mismatch in “is ... or have” is interpretive uncertainty rather than a fact value. The permitted fragment can express competing connective attachments, but neither its vocabulary nor critic agreement establishes the intended attachment.
